name: Attribute mode crossed with currency — Total-Price tier matrix in non-USD
what_it_tests: A Total-Price-mode attribute line (Base_Price__c = exact matrix tier price) in a non-USD quote must read a currency-matched tier value, not a USD tier value then FX-multiply (which would double-apply or mismatch); ties D-02/D-05 attribute modes to G-03 currency-blind ABA/ATPS gap at the mode level
proc_mechanism: Attribute Value Pricing - Total Price Mode (Base_Price__c -> InputUnitPrice) + CalculationMatrix PriceModelType='Total Price' keyed WITH CurrencyIsoCode; must not FX-convert an already-currency-native tier nor read USD tier
expected_behavior: Tier price read from the EUR/GBP matrix row directly (no FX double-apply); if only USD tier exists, surfaced as no-match/error not silent USD value
test_setup: Alert Logic MDR 100-node Total-Price tier, EUR quote, verify net = EUR tier (not USD tier × 0.9346 and not raw USD)

run3_result.defectStep: Attribute Value Pricing - Total Price Mode (V21 steps 17-20: Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Total Price' -> Base_Price__c -> InputUnitPrice via AttributeVolumePricingPrehook composite key) feeding Currency Conversion - Net Unit Price / Unit Price Display / Net Total / Total Line Amount (V21 steps 33-36). The Total-Price tier composite key omits CurrencyIsoCode, so the USD CalculationMatrix tier row is matched; the Currency Conversion steps then FX-multiply that USD-anchored base by 0.9346, double-applying currency instead of reading the native EUR tier.
